title: Review of c58's continuous vortex trait on fresh seed 7 with a fresh mutation sequence: the favoured trait climbs to 1.1-1.3 against a twin that drifts to -0.4/-0.5 under the same draws; heredity holds at 86% (twin 72%), but split parents are not above the mean, so selection acts through survival, growth or fusion rather than birth rate
summary: Ran the finding's trait.py (its world.py, labkit segmentation and tracker) on fresh seed 7 with mut_seed 7, T=6000: favoured eps 0.3 and the identical-draw neutral twin eps 0 (same 114 mutation draws, sign sum -12), plus a labkit pack of the favoured arm (rerun/seed7, frames 2000, spf 150). Favoured: mean vortex trait 0.12 (t=1000) -> 0.74 -> 0.89 -> 1.24 (t=5000), mean 1.14 over t>=4000, dominant class 0 -> 2 -> 3; twin: -0.01 -> -0.19 -> -0.53, mean -0.38. Daughters keep the parent's class at 74/86 splits (twin 87/120), parent-daughter r 0.95 (twin 0.87), within-vortex spread 0.016, 0 trait jumps away from mutations. Split parents sit at the population mean (parent minus mean +0.008, 49% above; twin -0.014, 48%). Labkit: 29 vortices at the end, 48 persistent splits, generation 16, merge/split 0.97, 0 nucleations.

observations.H: trait_time_s7.png and t_s7_e0.3.json vs t_s7_e0.json: favoured mean trait 1.14 (t>=4000) vs twin -0.38 under identical draws whose signs sum to -12 (the climb runs against the mutation bias); class fidelity 86% (twin 72%), r 0.95; 0 off-mutation jumps; rerun/seed7/FACTS.md generation 16

controls_run.H: identical-draw neutral twin t_s7_e0.json (eps 0, same seed and mutation draws)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. Fidelity on my seed is 86%, lower than the author's 95-97%. The genealogy is reticulate (labkit merge/split 0.97, 1433 splits against 1384 merges), so 'daughters' include re-separations after fusions. The parents of persistent splits are not above the population mean in either arm, as the author found, so the trait does not rise through more births per parent. It must rise through survival, area growth or the gain-weighted trait of fused vortices. RUBRIC L7 asks for per-kind births and deaths, and these are still not reported. The fitness effect is a written gain factor that saturates (tanh), so the climb has a ceiling.
